note: Order from the 1-ID-C panel (p13, layout dated 2026-08-31). Panel sections: [IC1,IC2,Slit 1] [fourC] [Beam Conditioning System: IC3, L1-L6, AttenC, Slit 2, IC4] | [LabMotion SMS, DBA, Tomo D1, Stop, Shield, Varex D2, Lens7]. No hutch photos exist for C.

elements.name: IC2
elements.notes: A button 'IC1+2 trans' on the panel acts on these two ICs (function unknown).

elements.name: fourC
elements.notes: Circle on the panel. mpe_bluesky has a commented-out FourC('1idc:') device. Function not recorded.

elements.name: L1
elements.notes: Green marker drawn on the panel (probably in-beam indicator; unconfirmed).

elements.name: L5 (RD)
elements.notes: Greyed on the panel with suffix 'RD' (meaning unknown, perhaps removed/disabled). No code device.

elements.name: IC4
elements.notes: End of the C beam-conditioning box; a dotted line separates it from the sample/detector section.

elements.name: LabMotion SMS
elements.notes: samC (SMSCDevice) in mpe_bluesky. A small 'Labmotion' button sits below it on the panel.

elements.name: DBA
elements.notes: Tall bar after LabMotion SMS. No code device; meaning unknown (user to explain).

elements.name: Tomo D1
elements.notes: Green bar on the panel (probably in-beam indicator). Profile camera pg5 (1idSP5:, hutch C) is presumably the camera on it (unconfirmed).

elements.name: Shield
elements.notes: Probably the D2 shield (d2C has Mshield 1idcAMCI:m11).

elements.name: Varex D2
elements.notes: Green bar on the panel (probably in-beam indicator). Varex detector PV not found in mpe_bluesky.

elements.name: Lens7
elements.notes: Last item on the C panel, far downstream of Varex D2. No code device.
